# My robotics workbook

> [Download the Word version](Student_Workbook.docx) · This Markdown copy is generated from the DOCX. Update the DOCX, then run `python scripts/sync_documents.py --write` from the repository root. Print layout, page breaks, headers/footers, and writing-space height remain in Word.

Build something, test a robot and explain what you noticed. Four teams of three share two robots. Keep your own ideas and let each teammate try every job.

### Robot jobs

Driver: edit and start after the lane is clear. Navigator: predict, place the stopped robot and reset its payload. Observer: watch, measure and record one number, tick or phrase. Keep hands away while the robot moves.

### Build jobs

Builder connects pieces. Designer finds parts and checks the plan. Tester tries the model and suggests one improvement. Everyone builds. Switch jobs when your mentor calls time.

### Our agreement

We ask before Run, respect the lane, share the parts and controls, and stop when something is wrong. A surprising result gives us a new question. Our models stay in labeled team trays.

## Welcome to robotics

Today you will make a robot move and build something for it.

### Meet your team

Meet your mentors and teammates. Everyone will get time to build and try the robot. Your mentor will help you with each new step.

### Watch a robot in action

Watch the demonstration. You can share something you notice, ask a question or simply watch.

### Try an idea together

Choose a signal for your robot and make a removable mascot. Try a small change and see what happens.

### Help each other

Take turns with the controls and parts. Check that the lane is clear before starting. Anyone can call stop. Keep hands away while the robot moves.

There is time to explore, ask for help and try again.

## Reading the robot recipe

Edit the small student\_recipe section in the complete project. Helpers, ports and safety limits are prepared by mentors. Ask before changing them.

| **Example** | **Meaning** |
| --- | --- |
| await signal("Y") | Show a letter |
| await pause(500) | Wait half a second |
| await drive(180) | Turn the wheels half a rotation |
| travel = 180 | Give a number a name |
| for beat in range(3): | Repeat the indented actions three times |
| if reading &lt; threshold: | Choose an action when the comparison is true |
| await deliver() | Run the named action |

### Small repairs

Keep quotation marks around letters. Keep the colon after a loop or decision. Preserve indentation. Wheel degrees are not centimeters or the robot’s heading. Measure the real result.
